title: Tours, Pricing and Dates | R&SVP – Hio Ridge, Bridgton, Maine
description: Contact Susan at R&SVP in Bridgton, Maine, for a tour or pricing brochure. You can ask about dates before choosing one. Call or text 207.400.6353.
heading: Come see where you'd say your vows.
lede: A tour is a chance to see the barn and walk out to the ceremony field with Susan. If you're still comparing venues, you can ask for the pricing brochure first. No date yet? A season and approximate guest count are enough to start.
